text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After persistent invitations from Light Hello,
the mysterious producer, I visited her office today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umm.
The 'Grand Live'?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's said that in that once-a-year live event, every single Umamusume belonging to Tracen Academy participated on stage.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And that each and every one of them was
singing their feelings of gratitude toward their fans...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Every single Umamusume?!
Th-that's nothing short of a dream concert!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco wants to do it!
Yes, I'd love to give it a try!!"
choice_data_list: Why aren't you doing it now, though?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I believe it is likely because the Twinkle Series
has grown significantly larger than before.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...With more races and more registered Umamusume,
it seems the Grand Live format
can no longer cover it all."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: The Grand Live was originally an event that the Umamusume ran on their own. It became too much of a burden to prepare on the side.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: And one day, the URA supposedly suggested the idea of holding a "Winning Live" format.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If the primary purpose is to express gratitude for the support,
it would be far more efficient to do so after each race.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: If we tie it to the races, the URA can manage it. That should reduce the burden on the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The Winning Live garnered
even greater popularity than the Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who won, the Umamusume who lost,
and above all, their fans.
Everyone began to truly yearn for the center position.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
She truly captivated everyone.
So much so that they forgot all about the Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: The Winning Live became a dream for all Umamusume, helping to elevate the prestige of the Twinkle Series to even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't help but wonder a little...
...If some of the girls are mixing up the prerequisites with their true purpose.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Because people have become overly preoccupied with the idea that the Winning Live is a stage only for the winner.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If I don't win, if I don't take the center position,
I can't convey my gratitude to the fans.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You know. I don't want to get comfortable with this dance.
Because if I can just smile and dance it normally,
I feel like I'll never reach center position for the rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I want to provide them once more
with the stage known as the Grand Live."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: A place where the Umamusume could convey their gratitude to the fans, honestly and purely.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: URA Director
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... However, times have changed,
and now that Winning Lives are the mainstream,
I wonder if reviving it is really appropriate.

text_block_list.name: URA Director
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I don't believe any more events
that place a burden on the Umamusume are necessary.

text_block_list.name: URA Director
text_block_list.text: No requests have really come in from anyone, so...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Well then, what if we gather
supporters for the revival?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If that sentiment echoes throughout the entire academy,
would the board of directors reconsider their stance?

text_block_list.name: URA Director
text_block_list.text:
...It might at least raise the possibility
that it's worth considering.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the briefing on the current situation.
With that in mind, I would like to ask for your cooperation—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Falco will help too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I want to help! Because deep down,
everyone wants to live up to the fans' support!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please help me out too! I truly believe
this live performance is absolutely necessary!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if we need everyone's help,
why don't we try starting a petition or doing a promo live?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: A promotional live, you say?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I mean, Falco didn't even know the Grand Live existed in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So first, let's let them know!
That this is a Live where everyone can sing their gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Plus, when it comes to concerts, even if it's a song by someone you don't know and you didn't plan on listening at first,
you just end up tuning in anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I think that's because songs have power.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "If we sing with all our might asking everyone to 'Help out!', maybe more people will join in!?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And so, I've secured a stage
for the promotional live!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "We couldn't use the on-campus stage since this isn't an official school event, naturally, but..."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"To make up for it, I've rented a stage
that is closest to the academy and gets plenty of foot traffic!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I've already reached out to sound and lighting techs I know. We can start anytime as soon as preparations are complete!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, that's amazing!
We need to start the lesson right away!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Um, managing the schedule for the other dancer, reaching out to the dance instructor...
Ah, I need to figure out the setlist too...
With her head spinning, Smart Falcon holds her head in her hands.
"...Expecting her to handle all those duties by herself is really too much to ask."
choice_data_list: I'll handle adjusting the schedule and stuff
I'll handle adjusting the schedule and stuff

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?
Are you sure you can handle it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If there is anything I can help with,
please let me know! I will do my utmost!
choice_data_list: Let's all do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes!

So from here on, we'll need to train <chrname>
while preparing for live concert performances.

I've heard that dance and vocal lessons
share elements with regular training, such as
core stability exercises.

If you hold “Lessons” alongside training,
you might improve <chrname>'s abilities
and bring her closer to a successful concert!

"...Besides, the experience of performing live itself
might also contribute to <chrname>'s growth."

After feeling her out with a gentle inquiry,
I explain that our very first "1st Live" concert
will be held in late December.

To make the Grand Live a reality,
let's make the 1st Live a success first!
